event_definition: A new disclosure episode of either SEC Item 1.03 bankruptcy/receivership or explicit Item 2.04 missed debt principal/interest payment within (decision date, decision date + 60 calendar days]. Every 8-K/8-K/A with exact Item 1.03 qualifies without LLM payment review, including filings also containing 2.04. Item 2.04-only filings qualify only with QUALIFIED_DEFAULT / PAYMENT_FAILURE, HIGH certainty and evidence quotes. Acceleration/enforcement alone are unresolved. All recurrent episodes are retained, with disclosures no more than 90 days apart grouped together. Filing date defines disclosure timing. Quiet-gap reentry is operational, not verified cure. Unresolved 2.04-only candidate filings censor affected horizons and later rows; negative windows require issuer follow-up. This is a bankruptcy-or-payment-failure disclosure proxy, not a verified contractual payment-default probability.
sample: Eligible local companyfacts issuers with complete submissions histories and current SIC outside 6000-6999. All 1.03 filings qualify automatically. Earlier OpenAI 2.04 PAYMENT_FAILURE/BENIGN reviews are reused; other 2.04-only distress or missing reviews remain unresolved. All recurrent disclosure episodes, not just first-ever events, are eligible outcomes.

policy_scenario.gaps: start a new hypothetical assessment after a missing month
policy_scenario.reopening: no automatic reopening after zero within a continuous segment
policy_scenario.hard_stop: Recent known bankruptcy/receivership or payment-failure disclosure during the episode quiet-gap period; no claim of verified cure on re-entry.
policy_scenario.fallback: If no model passes the predeclared selection rule, report absence of validated improvement and use the constant training-prevalence benchmark for policy scenarios.

validation_status: Broader bankruptcy-or-payment-failure target specified after examination of earlier target results, including 2023-2025. Evaluation is retrospective, not untouched external validation. Standard sample minima retained.
